cells.gaps: No source found counts the health systems the identifier links, or says the roll-out has reached every public facility.
cells.note: The health identifier is tied to the national ID card, and about 100,000 hospital files were linked to it by July 2026 (TUN-002); CHU Sahloul had unified 180,000 by October (TUN-001). Records are matched across systems by a national identifier: 5.
